title: Pediatric Vaccination in a Changing World. Impact on Child Health, Vaccine Hesitancy, and Future Perspectives of Immunization
abstract: Introduction: Vaccination remains one of the most effective and cost‐efficient public health interventions, dramatically reducing childhood morbidity and mortality from vaccine‐preventable diseases. However, the global immunization landscape has recently been challenged by pandemic disruptions, misinformation, inequities in access, and resurgent outbreaks. The Aim is to synthesize current evidence on the health and societal impact of pediatric vaccination, examine determinants of vaccine hesitancy, and highlight future perspectives for immunization programs. Methods; A narrative review was conducted, integrating epidemiological data, modelling studies, and recent reports from WHO, UNICEF, and peer‐reviewed literature. Particular attention was given to trends in coverage, disease resurgence, and behavioral determinants of vaccine confidence. Results: Routine immunization has averted an estimated 154 million deaths since 1974, predominantly in children under five. Yet, in 2024, 14.3 million infants received no vaccine doses, and measles re‐emerged in multiple countries, threatening elimination status. Vaccine hesitancy was strongly influenced by misinformation, sociocultural factors, and trust in health systems. Evidence underscores that resilient health infrastructure, equitable access, and credible communication by frontline providers are essential to sustain progress. Conclusions: Scientific advances alone cannot secure immunization gains. Strengthening public trust, addressing behavioral determinants, and ensuring equitable delivery are critical for the future of pediatric vaccination.

title: Impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities on Immunization Coverage in Pakistan: Evidence from Secondary Data Analysis (2011–2021)
abstract: Background: Despite noteworthy progress in the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) for improving vaccination coverage worldwide, inequalities in vaccine uptake and accessibility persist in several middle- and low-income states. Pakistan’s routine vaccination uptake varies greatly between federal geographical regions and continues to fall below the standard threshold needed to attain optimal herd immunity. The Federal Directorate of Immunization (FDI) in collaboration with the provincial Expanded Program on Immunizations implemented Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs) to boost immunization delivery in selected districts in order to address immunization coverage gaps in marginalized and difficult-to-reach communities. The purpose of this secondary data research was to evaluate whether EOAs improved immunization coverage in the country. Methods: The Federal Directorate of Immunization’s longitudinal panel analysis of district–month administrative data for the years 2011–2021 have been analyzed. The research investigation reviewed 158 districts’ monthly vaccination records for multiple antigens, covering regions where EOAs were successfully carried out in particular months. National and subnational analyses were carried out to measure geographical variations in the impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs). The average vaccination coverage during EOAs and non-EOAs months was compared using the paired t-test. Results: An aggregate of 2430 months with EOAs were included in the analysis of 19,068 monthly district observations. National level analysis revealed higher average vaccinations during the EOA months for all antigens, but a statistically significant increase was observed for IPV and measles second dose (p < 0.05) only. Provincial-level results indicate that the impact was more evident in underserved regions. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Punjab, and Sindh demonstrated statistically significant increases in vaccination counts for most antigens. Due to variations in baseline population coverage, as well as health care sector capability, the extent of improvements differed throughout regions. Conclusions: In Pakistan, routine immunization counts has been improved via enhanced outreach initiatives, especially in provinces with lower initial vaccination rates and restricted accessibility to services. Strengthening outreach strategies, together with consistent fixed-site immunization services, is likely to accelerate progress toward equitable immunization coverage and contribute to achieving the Immunization Agenda 2030 goals.

source_records.abstract: Background: Despite noteworthy progress in the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) for improving vaccination coverage worldwide, inequalities in vaccine uptake and accessibility persist in several middle- and low-income states. Pakistan’s routine vaccination uptake varies greatly between federal geographical regions and continues to fall below the standard threshold needed to attain optimal herd immunity. The Federal Directorate of Immunization (FDI) in collaboration with the provincial Expanded Program on Immunizations implemented Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs) to boost immunization delivery in selected districts in order to address immunization coverage gaps in marginalized and difficult-to-reach communities. The purpose of this secondary data research was to evaluate whether EOAs improved immunization coverage in the country. Methods: The Federal Directorate of Immunization’s longitudinal panel analysis of district–month administrative data for the years 2011–2021 have been analyzed. The research investigation reviewed 158 districts’ monthly vaccination records for multiple antigens, covering regions where EOAs were successfully carried out in particular months. National and subnational analyses were carried out to measure geographical variations in the impact of Enhanced Outreach Activities (EOAs). The average vaccination coverage during EOAs and non-EOAs months was compared using the paired t-test. Results: An aggregate of 2430 months with EOAs were included in the analysis of 19,068 monthly district observations. National level analysis revealed higher average vaccinations during the EOA months for all antigens, but a statistically significant increase was observed for IPV and measles second dose (p < 0.05) only. Provincial-level results indicate that the impact was more evident in underserved regions. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Punjab, and Sindh demonstrated statistically significant increases in vaccination counts for most antigens. Due to variations in baseline population coverage, as well as health care sector capability, the extent of improvements differed throughout regions. Conclusions: In Pakistan, routine immunization counts has been improved via enhanced outreach initiatives, especially in provinces with lower initial vaccination rates and restricted accessibility to services. Strengthening outreach strategies, together with consistent fixed-site immunization services, is likely to accelerate progress toward equitable immunization coverage and contribute to achieving the Immunization Agenda 2030 goals.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究的重点是评估加强外展活动 (EOAs) 对巴基斯坦免疫覆盖率的影响,特别是针对 麻疹病毒 和相关实体。核心问题是,这些外展活动是否提高了边缘化和难以接触社区的 麻疹 率,尤其是 麻疹 和其他抗原。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础由联邦免疫局 (FDI) 2011-2021 年的纵向面板数据组成。审查方法包括分析 158 个地区的地区月行政数据,使用配对 t 检验比较 EOA 月份和非 EOA 月份的 疫苗接种 覆盖率。进行了国家和地方分析,以评估EOA影响的地理差异。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,国家级分析显示,所有抗原在 EOA 月份期间的平均 麻疹 均较高,麻疹 第二剂和 IPV 的增加具有统计学意义(p < 0.05)。省级结果表明,这种影响在服务欠缺的地区更为明显,其中开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省、俾路支省、旁遮普省和信德省的大多数抗原的 疫苗接种 计数显示出显着改善。结论是,加强外展活动提高了常规免疫覆盖率,特别是在初始 疫苗接种 率较低且服务可及性有限的省份。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究承认基线人口覆盖率和医疗保健部门能力存在差异,这可能解释了不同地区改善程度不同的原因。然而,它没有提供影响这些差异的具体机制或背景因素的详细信息。此外,该研究并未解决观察期之后 EOA 的长期可持续性或有效性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,加强外展战略与固定地点免疫服务相结合,可以加速实现公平免疫覆盖的进展。该研究强调了在服务欠缺地区采取有针对性的干预措施的必要性,并强调了一致实施 EOA 以实现 2030 年免疫议程目标的重要性。

abstract_zh: 背景:尽管扩大免疫计划(EPI)在提高全球 疫苗接种 覆盖率方面取得了显着进展,但在一些中低收入国家,疫苗 的吸收和可及性仍然存在不平等。巴基斯坦的常规 疫苗接种 吸收率在联邦地理区域之间差异很大,并且持续低于获得最佳群体免疫力所需的标准阈值。联邦免疫局 (FDI) 与省级免疫扩大计划合作实施了强化外展活动 (EOA),以促进选定地区的免疫接种服务,以解决边缘化和难以到达的社区的免疫覆盖率差距。这项二手数据研究的目的是评估 EOA 是否提高了该国的免疫覆盖率。方法:对联邦免疫局 2011-2021 年地区月行政数据的纵向面板分析进行了分析。该研究调查审查了 158 个地区的多种抗原的每月 疫苗接种 记录,涵盖了特定月份成功开展 EOA 的地区。进行了国家和国家以下各级的分析,以衡量加强外展活动 (EOAs) 影响的地理差异。使用配对 t 检验比较 EOA 和非 EOA 月份的平均 疫苗接种 覆盖率。结果:对 19,068 个月地区观察结果的分析中纳入了总计 2430 个月的 EOA。国家级分析显示,所有抗原在 EOA 月份期间的平均 麻疹 均较高,但仅在 IPV 和 麻疹 第二剂中观察到统计学上显着的增加 (p < 0.05)。省级结果表明,服务欠缺地区的影响更为明显。开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省、俾路支省、旁遮普省和信德省表现出大多数抗原的 疫苗接种 计数在统计学上显着增加。由于基线人口覆盖率以及医疗保健部门能力的差异,各地区的改善程度有所不同。结论:在巴基斯坦,通过加强外展活动,常规免疫计数得到了改善,特别是在初始 疫苗接种 率较低且服务可及性有限的省份。加强外展战略,加上一致的固定地点免疫服务,可能会加速实现公平免疫覆盖率的进展,并有助于实现《2030 年免疫议程》目标。

title: What Is Old Is New Again: Tips and Tricks for Recognizing and Treating Vaccine-Preventable Diseases of Childhood Presenting to the Emergency Department.
abstract: Across the globe, there has been a resurgence in vaccine-preventable diseases reflecting declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy and gaps in vaccine coverage. Vaccination was seen as one of the most successful public health interventions of the 20th century-as a consequence, many vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles and diphtheria were relegated to textbooks. With the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), it is an urgent priority to equip emergency physicians with the knowledge to rapidly identify and manage potential cases and strengthen public health measures to curb transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the resurgence of measles virus and related vaccine-preventable diseases, emphasizing the need for emergency physicians to recognize and manage these conditions effectively. It highlights the historical success of vaccination in reducing measles disease and its re-emergence due to declining immunity and vaccine hesitancy. The authors stress the importance of strengthening public health measures and improving diagnostic capabilities in emergency settings. source_body_en: Across the globe, there has been a resurgence in vaccine-preventable diseases reflecting declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy and gaps in vaccine coverage. Vaccination was seen as one of the most successful public health interventions of the 20th century-as a consequence, many vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles and diphtheria were relegated to textbooks. With the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), it is an urgent priority to equip emergency physicians with the knowledge to rapidly identify and manage potential cases and strengthen public health measures to curb transmission.

title: Classification of scenarios based on the determinants of childhood vaccination coverage in Brazil
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Vaccination coverage in Brazil declined between 2015 and 2022, followed by a recovery in 2023 and 2024. Given this instability, driven by multiple determinants, we sought to identify factors associated with childhood vaccination and group Brazilian municipalities into scenarios that could guide interventions to improve coverage. Methods In this ecological study of 5,274 Brazilian municipalities, we assessed the rate of children under 1 year unvaccinated with the third dose of the Inactivated Poliovirus Vaccine (IPV) in 2024, chosen for its high correlation with other tracer vaccines such as Diphtheria, Tetanus and Pertussis (DTP) and Measles, Mumps and Rubella (MMR). We applied a hierarchical model with three levels of determinants (socioeconomic, health service structure, and operational), using Poisson regression to estimate standardized Rate Ratios (RR), followed by a K-means cluster analysis to identify municipal profiles. Results Several determinants were associated with higher rates of unvaccinated children, most notably the proportion of the population not covered by Community Health Workers (CHW) (RR = 1.15; 95% CI 1.14-1.15) and inequality measured by the Gini Index (RR = 1.33; 95% CI 1.32-1.34). We identified six municipal profiles that differed in tracer-vaccine coverage up to four years of age and in the composite Vaccination Needs Index (VNI). Conclusion Multiple socioeconomic, structural and operational factors were associated with unvaccinated rates, highlighting the relevance of healthcare service organization even in favorable social contexts. Classifying municipalities into risk profiles may support more targeted interventions aligned with local needs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 巴西的 疫苗接种 覆盖率在 2015 年至 2022 年期间下降,随后于 2023 年和 2024 年恢复。鉴于这种由多种决定因素驱动的不稳定因素,我们试图确定与儿童 疫苗接种 相关的因素,并将巴西各城市划分为可以指导干预措施以提高覆盖率的情景。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项针对 5,274 个巴西城市的生态研究评估了 2024 年未接种第三剂灭活脊髓灰质炎病毒 疫苗 (IPV) 的 1 岁以下儿童的比例,之所以选择该病毒,是因为它与白喉、破伤风和百日咳 (DTP) 以及 麻疹、流行性腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 等其他示踪剂 疫苗 高度相关。
elements_zh.methods: 我们应用了具有三个级别的决定因素(社会经济、卫生服务结构和运营)的分层模型,使用泊松回归来估计标准化比率 (RR),然后进行 K 均值聚类分析来识别市政概况。
elements_zh.main_results: 有几个决定因素与较高的未接种疫苗率有关,最显着的是社区卫生工作者 (CHW) 未覆盖的人口比例(RR = 1.15;95% CI 1.14-1.15)和基尼指数衡量的不平等(RR = 1.33;95% CI 1.32-1.34)。我们确定了六个市政概况,其追踪器 疫苗 覆盖范围(长达四年)和综合 疫苗接种 需求指数(VNI)有所不同。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 多种社会经济、结构和运营因素与未接种疫苗率相关,这凸显了医疗保健服务组织的相关性,即使在有利的社会环境下也是如此。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 将城市划分为风险状况可能会支持根据当地需求采取更有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 巴西的 疫苗接种 覆盖率在 2015 年至 2022 年期间有所下降,随后于 2023 年和 2024 年恢复。鉴于这种由多种决定因素驱动的不稳定因素,我们试图确定与儿童 疫苗接种 相关的因素,并将巴西各城市划分为可指导干预措施以提高覆盖率的情景。方法 在这项针对巴西 5,274 个城市的生态研究中,我们评估了 2024 年未接种第三剂灭活脊髓灰质炎病毒 疫苗 (IPV) 的 1 岁以下儿童的比例,选择该病毒是因为它与其他示踪剂 疫苗 如白喉、破伤风和百日咳 (DTP) 以及 麻疹、流行性腮腺炎和风疹具有高度相关性(MMR)。我们应用了具有三个级别的决定因素(社会经济、卫生服务结构和运营)的分层模型,使用泊松回归来估计标准化比率 (RR),然后进行 K 均值聚类分析来识别市政概况。结果 几个决定因素与较高的未接种疫苗率有关,最显着的是社区卫生工作者 (CHW) 未覆盖的人口比例(RR = 1.15;95% CI 1.14-1.15)和基尼指数衡量的不平等(RR = 1.33;95% CI 1.32-1.34)。我们确定了六个市政概况,其追踪器 疫苗 覆盖范围(长达四年)和综合 疫苗接种 需求指数(VNI)有所不同。结论 多种社会经济、结构和运营因素与未接种疫苗率相关,这凸显了医疗保健服务组织的相关性,即使在有利的社会环境下也是如此。将城市划分为风险状况可能会支持根据当地需求采取更有针对性的干预措施。

title: Assessment of post-vaccination immunity to airborne infections in children and adolescents from the Republic of Karelia
abstract: Seroepidemiological studies are essential for epidemiological surveillance of vaccine-preventable airborne infections prevented in children through using combination vaccines. The aim of the study was to assess post-vaccination immunity to diphtheria, pertussis, measles, rubella and mumps in children and adolescents living in the Republic of Karelia. Materials and methods. Results of seromonitoring in study groups of children and adolescents in the Republic of Karelia in 2019–2024 were retrospectively analyzed. A high level of immunological protection was established only for diphtheria (0.7% seronegative among children 3–4 years and 1.0% among adolescents 16–17 years) and rubella (3–4 years — 1.7%, 9–10 years — 0.9%, 16–17 years — 2.2%). A total of 2.4% of children aged 3–4 years had no protective antibody titer to pertussis microbe in 2019–2021 and 67.9% in 2022–2024. The increase in the frequency of seronegative children coincided with increased incidence of infection and the beginning of using acellular vaccine. The agglutination test allows the detection of antibodies to the microorganism, but not to toxoid. The percentage of measles and mumps seronegative children aged 3–4 years was 9.1% and 19.5%, 9–10 years — 17.6% and 8.8%, among adolescents — 36.5% and 17.4%. An analysis of the epidemiological situation showed that seromonitoring data mirrored the state of post-vaccination immunity. The presence of antibodies to rubella in children seronegative to measles and mumps, and antitoxic antibodies to diphtheria at a high level in children seronegative to pertussis, excludes falsification of vaccination data or loss of vaccine immunogenicity due to violation of storage temperature conditions as potential causes of negative results. Our results demonstrate the importance of assessing antibodies to all simultaneously administered antigens and a need to expand a search for causes behind substantial level of seropositivity among children.
journal: Russian Journal of Infection and Immunity

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess post-vaccination immunity to diphtheria, pertussis, measles, rubella and mumps in children and adolescents in the Republic of Karelia, as seroepidemiological studies are essential for epidemiological surveillance of vaccine-preventable airborne infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis of seromonitoring results from children and adolescents in the Republic of Karelia was conducted between 2019–2024.
analysis.methods: Materials and methods involved seromonitoring to assess antibody levels against diphtheria, pertussis, measles, rubella and mumps using agglutination tests.
analysis.main_results: A high level of immunological protection was established for diphtheria (0.7% seronegative among children 3–4 years and 1.0% among adolescents 16–17 years) and rubella (3–4 years — 1.7%, 9–10 years — 0.9%, 16–17 years — 2.2%). For pertussis, 2.4% of children aged 3–4 years were seronegative in 2019–2021, increasing to 67.9% in 2022–2024. Measles seronegativity rates were 9.1% (3–4 years), 17.6% (9–10 years), and 36.5% (adolescents), while mumps rates were 19.5%, 8.8%, and 17.4%, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the increase in seronegative children coincided with increased infection incidence and the introduction of acellular vaccine, and the presence of antibodies to rubella in measles-seronegative children excluded falsification of vaccination data or storage temperature issues as causes of negative results.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of assessing antibodies to all simultaneously administered antigens and the need to investigate causes behind substantial seropositivity levels, informing surveillance and vaccination strategies for airborne infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study is retrospective and relies on seromonitoring data, which may not capture all factors influencing immunity, but the large sample size and direct observation of antibody levels provide robust findings.

Measles and mumps showed varying seronegativity rates across age groups. The authors concluded that seromonitoring data reflected the epidemiological situation and emphasized the need to investigate causes of seropositivity, excluding vaccination falsification or storage issues as explanations for negative results.

abstract_zh: 血清流行病学研究对于通过使用 疫苗 组合预防儿童可预防的空气传播感染的流行病学 疫苗 至关重要。该研究的目的是评估生活在卡累利阿共和国的儿童和青少年在 麻疹 后对白喉、百日咳、麻疹、风疹和腮腺炎的免疫力。材料和方法。对 2019-2024 年卡累利阿共和国儿童和青少年研究组的血清监测结果进行回顾性分析。仅针对白喉(3-4岁儿童血清阴性率为0.7%,16-17岁青少年血清阴性率为1.0%)和风疹(3-4岁 - 1.7%,9-10岁 - 0.9%,16-17岁 - 2.2%)建立了高水平的免疫保护。2019-2021年,共有2.4%的3-4岁儿童没有针对百日咳微生物的保护性抗体滴度,2022-2024年这一比例为67.9%。血清阴性儿童频率的增加与 发病率 感染的增加和​​开始使用无细胞 疫苗 相一致。凝集试验可以检测微生物的抗体,但不能检测类毒素的抗体。3-4岁儿童中麻疹和腮腺炎血清阴性的比例分别为9.1%和19.5%,9-10岁为17.6%和8.8%,青少年为36.5%和17.4%。对流行病学情况的分析表明,血清监测数据反映了 疫苗接种 后的免疫状态。麻疹 和腮腺炎血清阴性儿童中存在风疹抗体,百日咳血清阴性儿童中存在高水平的白喉抗毒抗体,排除了 疫苗接种 数据的伪造或由于违反储存温度条件而导致 疫苗 免疫原性丧失作为阴性结果的潜在原因。我们的结果证明了评估所有同时施用的抗原的抗体的重要性,以及需要扩大对儿童中大量血清阳性背后原因的搜索。

title: A new fractional order Rubella disease model and systems analysis
abstract: Abstract The field of modelling infectious and chronic diseases is of pivotal importance in determining treatment and prevention methods. A plethora of diseases and public health concerns, including but not limited to measles, influenza, cancer and HIV, are analysed through the utilisation of mathematical models. Decision support studies are conducted to ensure the effective utilisation of available resources. At this juncture, the modelling of epidemiological diseases has a significant role to play in the estimation of the course of the epidemic within the society. In this study, a novel fractional order rubella disease model is considered. The numerical implementation and stability analysis of the model are performed. The notion of fractional derivatives is employed in the Caputo sense. Mathematical analyses of the fractional-order rubella disease model are conducted and numerical results are obtained through the implementation of the Generalized Euler method. Graphs are then generated to illustrate the findings. Based on the results of the sensitivity analysis, assuming all other parameters remain constant, the fundamental parameters represented by the transmission rate and the birth/natural death rates exhibit positive sensitivity indicators. Elevated values of these parameters have been determined to exert a substantial influence on the propagation of rubella within the community. Conversely, an increase in ratios with negative sensitivity indicators, such as the recovery rate and vaccination rate, has been demonstrated to function as a control mechanism to minimize the spread of rubella. Consequently, monitoring and managing these parameters should be prioritized by healthcare providers and policymakers to achieve the successful eradication of rubella.
journal: Journal of Nonlinear Complex and Data Science

title: A Situation Analysis of Parental Awareness Regarding Childhood Hearing Loss to Inform Health Communication Strategy
abstract: Introduction Early detection through universal newborn hearing screening (UNHS) and timely intervention can improve speech, language, and cognitive outcomes. However, limited awareness among caregivers remains a major barrier to early identification and management. This study performed a situation analysis of parental knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) to identify strategic barriers and inform a targeted health communication strategy. Methods A cross-sectional, questionnaire-based study was conducted at a tertiary care hospital in North India from November 2023 to October 2024. A total of 494 participants were recruited. Data were collected through a pre-validated, semi-structured questionnaire administered via face-to-face interviews in Hindi. abstract_zh: 引言 通过新生儿普遍听力筛查(UNHS)进行早期检测和及时干预可以改善言语、语言和认知结果。然而,照顾者认知有限仍然是早期识别和管理的主要障碍。本研究对父母的知识、态度和实践(KAP)进行了情况分析,以确定战略障碍并为有针对性的健康传播策略提供信息。方法 于2023年11月至2024年10月在印度北部的一家三级护理医院进行了一项横断面、基于问卷的研究。共招募了494名参与者。数据通过预先验证的半结构化问卷收集,通过印地语面对面访谈进行。该工具收集了关于风险因素和早期诊断的知识、对筛查和治疗的态度以及与预防和就医相关的实践。数据收集后,使用约翰霍普金斯"P-Process"框架制定情况分析和SWOT(优势、劣势、机会和威胁)矩阵,将原始结果综合为战略路线图。结果 情况分析揭示了一个"服务利用悖论":虽然420名(85.0%)参与者支持新生儿听力筛查,但存在严重的"随访冷漠",有454名(91.9%)错误地认为后续检测不必要。对"可见"风险(如耳漏(459名,92.9%)和麻疹(405名,82.0%))的认知程度高,但对"不可见"的产前和围产期风险(如NICU住院和母体感染)的认知仍然较差。SWOT分析将高学历水平和疫苗接种依从性(396名,80.2%)确定为核心优势和机会。然而,这些优势受到对政府设施认知不足(30名,6.1%)和外部威胁(结果悲观主义)的抵消,即不到一半的参与者认为受影响儿童能够实现正常的言语发育。结论 该研究强调了一个战略机会,即通过将听力健康教育整合到免疫接种诊所,利用高疫苗接种依从性。有针对性的传播策略必须专注于解决随访冷漠和结果误解问题,以弥合初始筛查与长期康复之间的差距。

title: Lettice Kinnersley
abstract: Lettice Kinnersley (1573–1632) was the youngest daughter of Richard Bagot (1530–1597) and Mary Saunders (b. She had two older brothers, Walter (1557–1622) and Anthony (b. 1558), and three older sisters, Margaret Trew (1551–1587), Ann Broughton (1555–1619), and Dorothy Okeover (1562–1628). In 1601, at the age of 28, she married Francis Kinnersley. They had a son, Thomas, in 1603, and perhaps two other boys, Ned and Dick, who are mentioned as having measles in a letter from her husband to her brother. Francis was estranged from his father, Anthony Kinnersley, and both Lettice and Francis came to rely on Lettice’s oldest brother, Walter Bagot, who had inherited her father’s estate in 1597, as an intermediary and confidant. Lettice’s marriage was fraught with financial and familial difficulties.

title_zh: 莱蒂斯·金纳斯利
source_body_en: Lettice Kinnersley (1573–1632) was the youngest daughter of Richard Bagot (1530–1597) and Mary Saunders (b. She had two older brothers, Walter (1557–1622) and Anthony (b. 1558), and three older sisters, Margaret Trew (1551–1587), Ann Broughton (1555–1619), and Dorothy Okeover (1562–1628). In 1601, at the age of 28, she married Francis Kinnersley. They had a son, Thomas, in 1603, and perhaps two other boys, Ned and Dick, who are mentioned as having measles in a letter from her husband to her brother. Francis was estranged from his father, Anthony Kinnersley, and both Lettice and Francis came to rely on Lettice’s oldest brother, Walter Bagot, who had inherited her father’s estate in 1597, as an intermediary and confidant. Lettice’s marriage was fraught with financial and familial difficulties.

While the evidence strength is moderate, the study offers valuable insights for improving vaccination rates and controlling measles outbreaks.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究针对当前的 麻疹 流行病,旨在确定学校可以实施的循证方法,以促进儿童 麻疹 的发展。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾了学校在 麻疹 流行期间促进儿童 麻疹 的循证策略。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及回顾有关学校环境中 麻疹 暴发 和 疫苗接种 推广策略的现有文献和数据。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究确定了学校可以在 麻疹 流行期间促进儿童 麻疹 的具体循证方法。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,学校在 疫苗接种 推广中发挥着关键作用,并提供适合学校环境的新颖的基于证据的策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为公共卫生政策和学校干预措施提供信息,以提高 麻疹 率并控制 麻疹 暴发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于现有文献和数据,而没有进行初步研究。

full_text: Abstract Measles persists as a major public-health challenge in Ethiopia, where recurrent outbreaks are driven by suboptimal routine immunization and high susceptibility among children. To characterize these dynamics more accurately, this study investigates a fractional-order measles model using the Caputo derivative, enabling the incorporation of memory and hereditary effects that are not captured by classical integer-order formulations. Model parameters, including the fractional order, are calibrated using weekly Ethiopian measles incidence data. The best-fit model corresponds to \(\alpha = 0.86\) and yields a \(3.4\%\) reduction in Root Mean Square Error together with lower Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian Information Criterion values compared to the integer-order model. Within this framework, a fractional optimal control problem is developed by introducing time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls. The optimality conditions derived via Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle are solved numerically to evaluate alternative intervention strategies. Quantitatively, the combined vaccination–treatment strategy reduces the final number of infections by \(94\%\) relative to the uncontrolled scenario at \(\alpha = 0.86\) and achieves a \(60\%\) reduction compared with its integer-order counterpart; it also lowers the total control cost by approximately \(28\%\) under fractional dynamics. Overall, the fractional model provides a more flexible representation of measles transmission by accounting for delayed response and long-range temporal effects inherent in real epidemics. The findings demonstrate that optimally timed, memory-aware vaccination strategies can significantly reduce both disease burden and implementation cost in settings such as Ethiopia, where gaps in routine immunization continue to sustain measles circulation. The findings demonstrate that optimally timed, memory-aware vaccination strategies can significantly reduce both disease burden and implementation cost in settings such as Ethiopia, where gaps in routine immunization continue to sustain measles circulation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform the development of more effective and cost-effective intervention strategies for measles control in similar high-risk settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to Ethiopian measles incidence data and may not be generalizable to other settings with different epidemiological characteristics. analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the persistent public-health challenge of measles in Ethiopia by developing a fractional-order model that incorporates memory and hereditary effects not captured by classical integer-order models. Calibrated using weekly Ethiopian incidence data, the model demonstrates superior fit with a fractional order of 0.86, reducing Root Mean Square Error by 3.4% compared to integer-order models. The introduction of time-dependent vaccination and treatment controls, optimized via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle, achieves a 94% reduction in infections relative to uncontrolled scenarios and a 60% reduction compared to integer-order counterparts, while lowering control costs by 28%. The findings highlight the potential of memory-aware strategies to enhance measles control in settings with routine immunization gaps, offering a more flexible and cost-effective approach to epidemic management.

full_text: Abstract The 2025/2026 measles resurgence in North America highlighted that antivirals may be valuable in protecting child health because of mounting vaccination hesitancy. The drug candidate GHP-88310 is an orally efficacious broad-spectrum orthoparamyxovirus polymerase inhibitor, but its effect on viral transmission is unclear. Here we used canine distemper virus, which causes measles-like disease in ferrets, and established direct-contact and airborne canine distemper virus transmission models to examine pharmacological suppression of virus spread. Prophylactic GHP-88310 administration alleviated clinical signs of direct contacts and all sentinels survived. Pre- and post-exposure prophylactic GHP-88310 given twice daily to air contacts prevented transmission. Once-daily prophylactic administration mediated complete survival with all air contacts undergoing seroconversion. Therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated clinical signs, and animals survived, whereas all vehicle-treated air contacts succumbed. Therapeutic treatment of infected source animals shortened the contagious phase by 5 days. These results establish conceptual proof that GHP-88310 can suppress social contact transmission. Therapeutic treatment of sources promises epidemiological gain in addition to therapeutic benefit. Main In 2001, the measles initiative was launched with the objective of establishing global measles virus (MeV) control through vaccination and a possible endgame of global measles eradication1,2. Enormous progress was made towards this goal, but global measles deaths have plateaued at around 100,000 per year since 2012 without further improvement3,4. Predominantly parental vaccination hesitancy has since resulted in re-emergence of MeV in geographical areas after elimination such as the UK5, facilitated persistent transmission in large regions including central and eastern Europe6,7 and in 2025 set the stage for the largest measles outbreak in decades in the United States with over 2,280 confirmed cases, hundreds of hospitalizations and 3 deaths8. Expanding from an epicentre in West Texas, thousands of additional cases were reported in Canada and Mexico8,9,10. Hospitalizations and case fatalities had no apparent impact on parental risk perception of vaccination versus infection11,12,13. As current trends project a further decline in vaccination rates14,15,16, future cyclical measles outbreaks in North America are inevitable, and additional options for measles control other than traditional ring vaccination are urgently needed to improve disease management and block virus spread. MeV is an orthoparamyxovirus of the morbillivirus genus17,18 that spreads through the respiratory route. All paramyxoviruses are enveloped, single-stranded RNA viruses of negative polarity that replicate in the cytosol of infected cells, relying on the virus-encoded RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) complex for both amplification of their RNA genomes and expression of their proteins19. Measles first presents with high fever and coryza after an incubation period of 10–14 days, followed by the characteristic maculopapular rash, conjunctivitis and diarrhoea20,21. Patients become contagious shortly after the emergence of clinical signs and continue to shed the virus until approximately 4 days after the onset of rash22. Well-behaved antivirals may contribute to addressing the measles problem through improved disease management and suppression of viral spread beyond index cases. This intended use defines key parameters of the target product profile of a viable measles drug. We require that a therapeutic is orally bioavailable for efficient administration to outpatients, is suitable for stockpiling at ambient conditions given the acyclical nature of measles outbreaks, carries a tolerability profile compatible with the high demands of a predominantly paediatric patient population and has an indication spectrum that includes an established path to clinical testing. We have previously developed two structurally distinct non-nucleoside inhibitor classes of the MeV RdRP complex, the pan-morbillivirus compound ERDRP-051923 and the broad-spectrum orthoparamyxovirus inhibitor GHP-88309, which blocks multiple clinically important pathogens in this subfamily24,25. Identified originally in a high-throughput drug screening campaign against the related orthoparamyxovirus human parainfluenza virus type 3 (HPIV3), GHP-88309 showed broad-spectrum anti-orthoparamyxovirus activity against HPIV3, a respirovirus, MeV and canine distemper virus (CDV), and emerging members of the henipavirus genus24,25,26. Mechanistic characterization through photo-affinity target mapping, biochemical RdRP assays and viral resistance profiling showed that the compound binds to the central cavity of the orthoparamyxovirus polymerase (L) protein and prevents RdRP initiation at the viral promoter24. Consequently, GHP class inhibitors interrupt the viral life cycle by blocking both RdRP replicase and transcriptase activity. Because MeV is a human-tropic virus without animal reservoir, we established closely related CDV25 infection of ferrets, one of its natural hosts, as a surrogate assay to study drug efficacy. Whereas CDV recapitulates all hallmarks of severe morbillivirus disease27, it exceeds MeV in pathogenicity as infected ferrets succumb invariably 10–14 days post infection (d.p.i.)25,28. We demonstrated that both ERDRP-0519 and GHP-88309 mediate complete survival and alleviate clinical signs when administered therapeutically25,28 and identified a viable therapeutic time window for treatment of morbillivirus disease with GHP-88309 (ref. 25). However, although prophylactically administered ERDRP-0519 statistically significantly prolonged time to death, animals ultimately succumbed28. The GHP-88309 chemotype was therefore selected for further development on the basis of its superior oral efficacy against morbilliviruses and its broader indication spectrum. Specifically, GHP-class compounds, but not ERDRP-0519, are orally efficacious against HPIV3 and related respiroviruses24,25, promising a viable path to clinical testing in adult volunteers as haematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients are highly vulnerable to HPIV3 infection with mortality rates of up to 75% (refs. 29,30). In recent work, we developed a clinical candidate of the GHP class, GHP-88310, that addressed an unexpected tolerability limit of original GHP-88309 in higher mammals through synthetic optimization31. In this Article, we explored the efficacy of GHP-88310 in suppressing morbillivirus transmission when used prophylactically or therapeutically. Air-contact transmission models are established for, for instance, influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 (refs. 32,33,34,35) to study airborne virus spread under physiological conditions but are lacking for morbilliviruses. Here, we established a robust CDV ferret airborne transmission model that revealed a strong correlation between disease dynamics and mechanism of infection. To capture both symptomatic and non-symptomatic infections, we used the emergence of clinical signs or seroconversion of immunologically naive contact animals and production of neutralizing antibodies as markers for successful transmission36. We demonstrate that pre- and post-exposure prophylactic (PREP and PEP) treatment of air contacts with GHP-88310 prevents morbillivirus transmission. Therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated infection, and therapeutic treatment of infected sources abbreviated the contagious phase. Results Paramyxoviruses spread through direct contact, fomites and airborne respiratory droplets and aerosols. To establish a CDV ferret morbillivirus transmission model, we explored co-housing of infected source and contact animals, recapitulating household transmission through physical contact, and shared airspace conditions, representing airborne transmission in social settings. Prophylactic GHP-88310 prevents clinical disease in direct-contact animals Sequence authentication confirmed that the CDV inoculum used in this study, recombinant CDV-5804p (ref. 37), was genetically identical to the CDV-5804p strain used previously for receptor binding site mapping38,39, ensuring binding competence to both cognate receptors relevant for efficient CDV host invasion and dissemination, canine signalling lymphocyte activation molecule (SLAM) and nectin-4 (Extended Data Table 1). We first examined direct-contact transmission, co-housing infected source animals with uninfected sentinels at a ratio of 1:3 per cage for 8 days, from 3 d.p.i. until sources succumbed to the disease (Fig. 1a). Recapitulating prophylactic treatment in a regional outbreak situation, 12 h before co-housing, each of the three contacts per cage received GHP-88309 at the highest tolerated dose of 50 mg kg−1 orally25,31, clinical candidate analogue GHP-88310 at a matching dose of 150 mg kg−1 orally based on approximately equal plasma exposure31, or vehicle volume equivalent. Treatments were continued in twice daily (bis in die, b.i.d.) regimens. We sampled all animals daily for shed virus titres in nasal lavages, determined complete blood counts (CBC) and viraemia titres in 3–4 day intervals, and assessed neutralizing antibody (nAb) titres weekly. Sampling of individual groups was discontinued when nasal lavages and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were virus-negative for 3 consecutive measurements, when animals succumbed, or at 35 days after study start. The median survival of untreated source animals was until 11 d.p.i. (Fig. 1b), which fully matched our extensive experience with this model25,31. Clinical signs emerged first at 3 d.p.i. and comprised, in order of appearance, fever, body weight loss, rash, diarrhoea and conjunctivitis (Extended Data Fig. 1a–e). Animals became viraemic 3 d.p.i. (Fig. 1c) and started to efficiently shed virus into nasal lavages 7 d.p.i. (Fig. 1d). All vehicle-treated contacts succumbed by study day 19 (Fig. 1b), indicating that transmission occurred on study days 7–8, correlating an upper respiratory CDV load of approximately 103 50% tissue culture infectious dose (TCID50) units per ml with productive spread. All contacts in the prophylactic GHP-88310 group remained disease-free during the duration of the study, and none became viraemic or virus positive in nasal lavages (Fig. 1c,d). By contrast, prophylactic GHP-88309 delayed onset, and alleviated severity, of clinical signs, but all animals of this group became viraemic and started to shed efficiently into nasal lavages, and a majority (2 of 3 animals) ultimately succumbed with a median survival of 32 days, resembling our previous experience with the structurally unrelated morbillivirus polymerase inhibitor ERDRP-0519 (ref. 28). Consistent with complete suppression of viraemia by GHP-88310, none of the animals in the group experienced any change in CBC profile, whereas animals treated with GHP-88309 suffered from severe, albeit transient, morbillivirus lymphocytopaenia, which matched in intensity that of the vehicle cohort (Fig. 1e). Two of three animals in the GHP-88310 group and the single survivor in the GHP-88309 group mounted a protective nAb response approximately 3 weeks after co-housing (Fig. 1f). Dynamics of airborne morbillivirus transmission For long-distance transmission, we explored open air contact (oAC) and closed air contact (cAC) settings in comparison (Fig. 2a), placing source and contacts ferrets in parallel open cages or in closed cages connected through an air tube with directional flow, respectively. Contact time was 5–11 d.p.i. with a source-to-contact ratio of 1:3 in either setting. At the end of the air-exposure period, contact animals were separated into individual ventilated cages to prevent delayed secondary spread and monitored as before until study day 40. The median survival of animals in the cAC cohort was until study day 21 (Fig. 2b), indicating that transmission reliably occurred within the first 4–5 days of shared airspace. Viraemia and shed virus load profiles were highly consistent across all animals in the group (Fig. 2c,d), confirming synchronized transmission under these conditions. By contrast, oAC sentinels succumbed over a broad 2 week period (median survival until study day 30.5), and the onset of viraemia and virus shedding was highly variable between individual animals over a wide time window (Fig. 2b–d), attesting to overall less efficient virus spread with respect to both time to productive infection and inoculum amount transferred. A comparison of the onset of major morbillivirus-associated clinical signs after natural airborne transmission in oAC or cAC settings versus artificial intranasal inoculation illuminated a strong correlation between disease dynamics and route of infection (Fig. 2e). In each setting, all contacts were eventually infected and succumbed to the disease. However, artificially inoculated animals developed the first clinical signs (fever) 3 d.p.i., whereas cAC animals showed the first signs of disease 5 days, and oAC animals 9 days, after contact start. All individual animals in the natural infection, cAC and oAC cohorts presented with at least one disease marker at 5, 11 and 28 days after exposure, respectively. We selected the cAC setting for subsequent experiments, as it combined the natural route of infection with a predictable disease timeline. PREP and PEP GHP-88310 suppresses airborne viral transmission In addition to the vehicle control arm, we explored four GHP-88310 treatment regimens to mitigate airborne transmission (Fig. 3a): PREP at 150 mg kg−1 b.i.d.; therapeutic at 150 mg kg−1 b.i.d., started 3 days after exposure to simulate PEP; therapeutic at 150 mg kg−1 b.i.d., started therapeutically 6 days after exposure when the first clinical signs emerged; and PREP at 100 mg kg−1 once daily (quaque die, q.d.), reducing the daily dose to the previously determined lowest efficacious level after artificial inoculation31. At the end of the air-contact periods, sentinels were again transferred into individual ventilated cages. All animals in each treatment cohort survived, whereas all vehicle-treated animals succumbed with a median survival of 21 days (Fig. 3b). Before death, animals in the vehicle cohort displayed major clinical signs, whereas animals of the q.d. group showed only minor, transient disease symptoms and animals in all b.i.d. groups remained disease-free (Extended Data Fig. 2a–e). Lymphocytopaenia was severe and rapid in vehicle animals, moderate and transient in the q.d. group and fully mitigated in all animals receiving the b.i.d. regimen (Fig. 3c). Of the b.i.d.-treated animals, only those in the cohort started 6 days after air exposure developed transient mild viraemia (Fig. 3d), but the virus remained undetectable in nasal lavages (Fig. 3e). By contrast, q.d.-dosed sentinels became moderately viraemic and transiently shed virus. However, peak viraemia and shed titres remained 1–2 orders of magnitude below those of the vehicle-treated cohort. PEP cohorts, indicating complete suppression of transmission, and in 1 of 3 animals of the 6 d.p.c. therapeutic group. Confirming nAb titration results, only q.d. and the two 6 d.p.c. animals with positive titre results survived a high-inoculum intranasal rechallenge with CDV 31 days after study start, whereas animals of the prophylactic and 3 d.p.c. b.i.d. cohorts and the single nAb-negative animal of the 6 d.p.i. b.i.d. group rapidly succumbed to the infection (Fig. 3g), underscoring that treatment with GHP-88310 preserved their CDV-naive immunological status. (Fig. 4a). In this study, sources received a reduced inoculum amount of 2 × 103 TCID50 units per animal, which we identified in pilot work as suitable to extend time to death by approximately 3 days in untreated animals (Extended Data Fig. 3), facilitating an expanded co-housing period without compromising overall outcome and disease dynamics (Extended Data Fig. 4a–h). Accordingly, direct-contact and cAC conditions were established for 5 days, from 10 to 15 d.p.i., when shed virus titres in nasal lavages of vehicle-treated source animals peaked (Fig. 4b) and viraemia titres remained high (Fig. 4c). In parallel, we initiated treatment of two additional infected animal groups 6 or 8 d.p.i., at the time of onset of fever or rash, respectively, to better appreciate the therapeutic time window of GHP-88310 (Fig. 4a). All 4 and 6 d.p.i.-GHP-88310-treated animals survived the infection (Fig. 4d) and experienced only transient viraemia with minimal virus shedding into the upper respiratory tract (Fig. 4b,c). By contrast, 1 of 3 animals in the 8 d.p.i. treatment group and vehicle-treated animals succumbed to CDV at 15 d.p.i., consistent with the results of our pilot study. These results define a therapeutic time window for GHP-88310 that extends 2 days beyond the onset of first clinical signs and closes only after viraemia peak, shortly following the onset of rash. All direct and air contacts of the GHP-88310-treated sources survived, none experienced weight loss or sustained fever (Extended Data Fig. 5a,b), and none developed any clinical signs of morbillivirus disease (Extended Data Fig. 5c–e). full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract The 2025/2026 measles resurgence in North America highlighted that antivirals may be valuable in protecting child health because of mounting vaccination hesitancy. The drug candidate GHP-88310 is an orally efficacious broad-spectrum orthoparamyxovirus polymerase inhibitor, but its effect on viral transmission is unclear. Here we used canine distemper virus, which causes measles-like disease in ferrets, and established direct-contact and airborne canine distemper virus transmission models to examine pharmacological suppression of virus spread. Prophylactic GHP-88310 administration alleviated clinical signs of direct contacts and all sentinels survived. Pre- and post-exposure prophylactic GHP-88310 given twice daily to air contacts prevented transmission. Once-daily prophylactic administration mediated complete survival with all air contacts undergoing seroconversion. Therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated clinical signs, and animals survived, whereas all vehicle-treated air contacts succumbed. Therapeutic treatment of infected source animals shortened the contagious phase by 5 days. These results establish conceptual proof that GHP-88310 can suppress social contact transmission. Therapeutic treatment of sources promises epidemiological gain in addition to therapeutic benefit. Main In 2001, the measles initiative was launched with the objective of establishing global measles virus (MeV) control through vaccination and a possible endgame of global measles eradication1,2. Enormous progress was made towards this goal, but global measles deaths have plateaued at around 100,000 per year since 2012 without further improvement3,4. Predominantly parental vaccination hesitancy has since resulted in re-emergence of MeV in geographical areas after elimination such as the UK5, facilitated persistent transmission in large regions including central and eastern Europe6,7 and in 2025 set the stage for the largest measles outbreak in decades in the United States with over 2,280 confirmed cases, hundreds of hospitalizations and 3 deaths8. Expanding from an epicentre in West Texas, thousands of additional cases were reported in Canada and Mexico8,9,10. Hospitalizations and case fatalities had no apparent impact on parental risk perception of vaccination versus infection11,12,13. As current trends project a further decline in vaccination rates14,15,16, future cyclical measles outbreaks in North America are inevitable, and additional options for measles control other than traditional ring vaccination are urgently needed to improve disease management and block virus spread. MeV is an orthoparamyxovirus of the morbillivirus genus17,18 that spreads through the respiratory route. All paramyxoviruses are enveloped, single-stranded RNA viruses of negative polarity that replicate in the cytosol of infected cells, relying on the virus-encoded RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) complex for both amplification of their RNA genomes and expression of their proteins19. Measles first presents with high fever and coryza after an incubation period of 10–14 days, followed by the characteristic maculopapular rash, conjunctivitis and diarrhoea20,21. Patients become contagious shortly after the emergence of clinical signs and continue to shed the virus until approximately 4 days after the onset of rash22. Well-behaved antivirals may contribute to addressing the measles problem through improved disease management and suppression of viral spread beyond index cases. This intended use defines key parameters of the target product profile of a viable measles drug. We require that a therapeutic is orally bioavailable for efficient administration to outpatients, is suitable for stockpiling at ambient conditions given the acyclical nature of measles outbreaks, carries a tolerability profile compatible with the high demands of a predominantly paediatric patient population and has an indication spectrum that includes an established path to clinical testing. We have previously developed two structurally distinct non-nucleoside inhibitor classes of the MeV RdRP complex, the pan-morbillivirus compound ERDRP-051923 and the broad-spectrum orthoparamyxovirus inhibitor GHP-88309, which blocks multiple clinically important pathogens in this subfamily24,25. Identified originally in a high-throughput drug screening campaign against the related orthoparamyxovirus human parainfluenza virus type 3 (HPIV3), GHP-88309 showed broad-spectrum anti-orthoparamyxovirus activity against HPIV3, a respirovirus, MeV and canine distemper virus (CDV), and emerging members of the henipavirus genus24,25,26. Mechanistic characterization through photo-affinity target mapping, biochemical RdRP assays and viral resistance profiling showed that the compound binds to the central cavity of the orthoparamyxovirus polymerase (L) protein and prevents RdRP initiation at the viral promoter24. Consequently, GHP class inhibitors interrupt the viral life cycle by blocking both RdRP replicase and transcriptase activity. Because MeV is a human-tropic virus without animal reservoir, we established closely related CDV25 infection of ferrets, one of its natural hosts, as a surrogate assay to study drug efficacy. Whereas CDV recapitulates all hallmarks of severe morbillivirus disease27, it exceeds MeV in pathogenicity as infected ferrets succumb invariably 10–14 days post infection (d.p.i.)25,28. We demonstrated that both ERDRP-0519 and GHP-88309 mediate complete survival and alleviate clinical signs when administered therapeutically25,28 and identified a viable therapeutic time window for treatment of morbillivirus disease with GHP-88309 (ref. 25). However, although prophylactically administered ERDRP-0519 statistically significantly prolonged time to death, animals ultimately succumbed28. The GHP-88309 chemotype was therefore selected for further development on the basis of its superior oral efficacy against morbilliviruses and its broader indication spectrum. Specifically, GHP-class compounds, but not ERDRP-0519, are orally efficacious against HPIV3 and related respiroviruses24,25, promising a viable path to clinical testing in adult volunteers as haematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients are highly vulnerable to HPIV3 infection with mortality rates of up to 75% (refs. 29,30). In recent work, we developed a clinical candidate of the GHP class, GHP-88310, that addressed an unexpected tolerability limit of original GHP-88309 in higher mammals through synthetic optimization31. In this Article, we explored the efficacy of GHP-88310 in suppressing morbillivirus transmission when used prophylactically or therapeutically. Air-contact transmission models are established for, for instance, influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2 (refs. 32,33,34,35) to study airborne virus spread under physiological conditions but are lacking for morbilliviruses. Here, we established a robust CDV ferret airborne transmission model that revealed a strong correlation between disease dynamics and mechanism of infection. To capture both symptomatic and non-symptomatic infections, we used the emergence of clinical signs or seroconversion of immunologically naive contact animals and production of neutralizing antibodies as markers for successful transmission36. We demonstrate that pre- and post-exposure prophylactic (PREP and PEP) treatment of air contacts with GHP-88310 prevents morbillivirus transmission. Therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated infection, and therapeutic treatment of infected sources abbreviated the contagious phase. Results Paramyxoviruses spread through direct contact, fomites and airborne respiratory droplets and aerosols. To establish a CDV ferret morbillivirus transmission model, we explored co-housing of infected source and contact animals, recapitulating household transmission through physical contact, and shared airspace conditions, representing airborne transmission in social settings. title_original: Antiviral GHP-88310 blocks contact-mediated and airborne transmission in a ferret model of measles-like disease

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of the antiviral compound GHP-88310 in blocking contact-mediated and airborne transmission of measles-like disease using a ferret model with canine distemper virus, addressing the need for interventions against morbillivirus transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a ferret model infected with canine distemper virus, a surrogate for measles virus, to establish direct-contact and airborne transmission models, with prophylactic and therapeutic treatment regimens evaluated in multiple cohorts.
analysis.methods: Researchers employed pharmacological suppression of virus spread, including prophylactic and therapeutic administration of GHP-88310, and measured transmission via clinical signs, seroconversion, viral load, and survival outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Prophylactic GHP-88310 administration alleviated clinical signs in direct contacts and ensured survival of all sentinels; therapeutic treatment of air contacts mitigated clinical signs and prevented mortality, whereas all vehicle-treated animals succumbed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted GHP-88310 as a potent inhibitor of morbillivirus transmission, demonstrating complete suppression of airborne spread and sterilizing effects in some cohorts, representing a novel therapeutic approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest GHP-88310 could be a viable intervention for measles-like diseases, with implications for outbreak control and post-exposure prophylaxis in high-risk populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relied on an animal model with a surrogate virus, limiting direct extrapolation to humans, but the robust experimental design and consistent results provide high confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral compound GHP-88310 in a ferret model using canine distemper virus to evaluate its efficacy against measles-like disease transmission. The researchers established direct-contact and airborne transmission models and tested prophylactic and therapeutic regimens. Results showed that prophylactic GHP-88310 alleviated clinical signs and ensured survival in direct contacts, while therapeutic treatment prevented mortality in air-exposed animals. The compound demonstrated complete suppression of airborne transmission in some cohorts, with sterilizing effects observed. The findings highlight GHP-88310 as a promising intervention for morbillivirus diseases, though the animal model limits direct human applicability.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用感染犬瘟热病毒(麻疹病毒 的替代品)的雪貂模型来建立直接接触和空气传播的 传播 模型,并在多个 队列研究 中评估预防和治疗 治疗 方案。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用药物抑制病毒传播,包括预防性和治疗性施用 GHP-88310,并通过临床症状、血清转化、病毒载量和生存结果测量 传播。
elements_zh.main_results: 预防性施用 GHP-88310 可减轻直接接触者的临床症状,并确保所有哨兵的生存;空气接触的治疗性 治疗 减轻了临床症状并预防了 死亡率,而所有媒介物治疗的动物均死亡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 GHP-88310 解释为麻疹病毒 传播 的有效抑制剂,证明了对某些 队列研究 的空气传播的完全抑制和消毒作用,代表了一种新颖的治疗方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,GHP-88310 可能是 麻疹 类疾病的可行干预措施,对高危人群的 麻疹 控制和暴露后预防具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于具有替代病毒的动物模型,限制了对人类的直接外推,但稳健的实验设计和一致的结果为研究结果提供了高度的可信度。

Volume 32, Number 9—September 2026 Dispatch Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026 Suggested citation for this article Abstract An ongoing measles outbreak in Israel, involving ≈3,200 cases and 16 deaths, threatens the country’s measles elimination status and reflects declining vaccination rates observed globally and within Israel. Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing suggest that a single importation triggered the outbreak, underscoring the critical role of rapid genomic surveillance in outbreak control. Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable disease; clinical manifestations typically include high fever, maculopapular rash, cough, and conjunctivitis. Severe complications, including pneumonia and encephalitis, can occur in up to 30% of cases, and the case-fatality rate is ≈1/1,000 cases (1). Despite an effective vaccine (measles, mumps, and rubella [MMR]), measles remains a major global health concern; in 2025, Romania, Vietnam, Morocco, and the United States reported outbreaks (2–4). In Israel, MMR vaccine coverage has declined in recent years to 83% receiving the first dose at <25 months of age and 87% a second dose at <8 years of age. Corresponding rates are 83% and 85% in Jerusalem and 89% and 93% in the Central District; coverage is lower in Ultra-Orthodox communities (Israel Ministry of Health, unpub. data). Israel achieved measles elimination in 2015, but outbreaks continue, including >4,000 cases in 2018–2019 and smaller outbreaks during 2023–2024 (5–7). We report on an ongoing measles outbreak that began in Israel in April 2025. During April 7, 2025–February 28, 2026, a total of 3,203 measles cases, including 16 deaths, were reported across Israel, the largest outbreak since 2018–2019 (8). Epidemiologic investigations found 13 case-patients had a history of travel abroad shortly before illness onset (Table). Among reported case-patients, mean age was 5.58 years (SD 9.35 years; range 1 month–73 years); 82.7% were unvaccinated, 7.1% were partially vaccinated, 2.2% were fully vaccinated, and 8.5% had unknown vaccination status. As part of routine surveillance, 132 measles virus–positive samples collected during April 2025–February 2026 were selected for sequencing (Appendix). Samples were sequenced on the basis of the following criteria: all available imported cases, all travel-associated cases, representative samples from newly affected areas, and randomized samples collected in established outbreak locations every 2 weeks throughout the outbreak. Samples were excluded from sequencing when epidemiologic data showed that transmission occurred in established measles-positive locations (i.e., same street or household) (Appendix). Complete measles virus genomes were sequenced (9) (Appendix) and used for phylogenetic analysis to support transmission chain reconstruction. The N450 region of the measles viral genome confirmed the sequences as genotype B3, matching the reference MVs/Quetta.PAK/44.20 strain from Pakistan. Phylogenetic analysis showed the Israel sequences clustered most closely with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States collected in 2025 (Figure 1); however, because up-to-date global sequence data in public repositories are limited, intermediate diversity could be missing. The Israel sequences showed 3 likely clusters within the dominant B3 lineage, each derived from a separate documented importation: Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia. We found no spread of D8 lineage sequences imported to Israel. The Russia cluster likely originated from a documented importation from Russia (patient 4; Rehovot, May 2025) and is linked to an additional sample collected in Haifa in June 2025. That cluster is most closely related to a global sequence from California, USA (2025), differing by 7 nucleotides. Transmission in the cluster was limited to only 2 cases because close contacts were fully vaccinated and that location has high overall vaccine coverage. The Vietnam cluster, separated from the nearest ancestor by 12 nt, likely originated from a documented importation from Vietnam (patient 3; Beit-Itzhak, April 2025) and is not linked to additional Israel cases in the phylogeny. No further transmission was documented in the cluster, consistent with sequencing results and similar to the Russia cluster. The main and largest cluster (n = 129) was traced through epidemiologic investigations to a documented importation from Belgium (patient 2; Modi’in Illit, April 2025). That case was diagnosed retrospectively through contact tracing of infected close family members. Although the imported case was confirmed serologically (positive IgM), the available specimen contained insufficient viral RNA, precluding sequencing. However, sequencing was available for an epidemiologically linked close contact of the imported case (Bnei-Brak, April 2025; Figure 1, red arrow), located within the main cluster; epidemiologic data indicated subsequent spread to additional cities in Central District, Jerusalem, and later North District. That cluster also includes an additional sequenced importation from Belgium (case 5; Jerusalem, June 2025), unrelated epidemiologically to the other Belgium cases, located on the ancestral branch. The main cluster is most closely related to global sequences from the Netherlands collected in 2025, differing by 2 mutations. That strain has subsequently spread in Israel and is still circulating, accumulating mutations and giving rise to several sublineages. Most samples in that cluster were from locations with low vaccine coverage and within Ultra-Orthodox communities (Figure 2; Appendix Table 3). The sequences obtained from deceased children were located within different sublineages in the main outbreak cluster (Figure 1). The first case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to 2 sequences detected elsewhere (Tel Aviv, September 2025; Emmanuel, August 2025). The second case (Jerusalem, July 2025) was identical to another from Jerusalem (June 2025). The third case (Poriya, November 2025) was identical to 2 cases from the North District (Nahariya, November 2025). The identical genomes suggest close epidemiologic linkage and, when detected in different districts, indicate transmission across multiple regions in Israel. That finding suggests the virus in fatal cases was typical of the outbreak strain. Three additional case-patients with documented travel abroad (patient 7, Poland; patient 10, Ethiopia; patient 12, Germany) near the time of measles detection had sequences within the main cluster, suggesting that infection was more likely acquired in Israel, not abroad. To investigate positivity dynamics from an epidemiologic perspective, we evaluated the weekly ratios of positive and negative samples collected during April–October 2025 (epidemiologic weeks 14–44). When the outbreak began, the positivity rate was low (10%–20%), likely reflecting heightened awareness and broad testing of suspected cases with low pretest probability for measles. As transmission became established in specific districts during weeks 28–38, positivity increased to ≈60%, indicating outbreak persistence and targeted sampling (Appendix). During weeks 39–44, as the outbreak expanded to additional districts, the overall ratio decreased (Figure 3); we observed a similar trend through February 2026 (data not shown). The ongoing measles outbreak in Israel threatens the country’s elimination status, defined by the World Health Organization as absence of endemic transmission for >12 months (https://iris.who.int/server/api/core/bitstreams/b0ee4708-ba01-4b40-9003-f6f1aba317da/content). This outbreak highlights the profound risks associated with declining vaccination coverage. Genomic sequencing of targeted measles samples indicated that a single importation event was most likely the primary driver of the outbreak. Phylogenetic analysis showed 3 validated distinct importation events from Russia, Vietnam, and Belgium; outcomes differed drastically based on local immunity. The main Belgium-linked cluster strain, detected in April 2025, likely sparked an extensive national outbreak. The second documented importation case from Belgium might have contributed to the main transmission cluster. The epidemiologic investigation indicated that this case-patient had many contacts and resided in an area experiencing a substantial outbreak. However, the case was detected 2 months after the Belgium index case, so it likely had little impact on outbreak dynamics. Furthermore, its shared mutations with the April 2025 Belgium case suggest a common source. Additional undetected single cases might exist because of underreporting. However, our strict criteria and direct contact to Ministry of Health epidemiologic data enabled systematic assessment of each focal point, so underreporting is unlikely to have substantially affected the main phylogenetic findings. Positivity rates rose from 10%–20% during early broad testing to 60% during weeks 28–38, as diagnostics shifted to targeted surveillance during outbreak spread. In summary, we integrated epidemiologic investigations with molecular surveillance, demonstrating that a single case can spark extensive measles transmission. Our findings highlight the critical role of molecular surveillance in measles outbreak management. Dr. Bucris is the head of the Measles and Rubella national center with Central Virology Laboratory, Public Health Services, Ministry of Health and Sheba Medical Center, Ramat-Gan, Israel. Her research interest is vaccine-preventable viral diseases. title_original: Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to investigate an ongoing measles outbreak in Israel that threatened the country's measles elimination status and reflected declining vaccination rates globally and within Israel.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A genomic and epidemiologic investigation was conducted in Israel from April 2025 to February 2026, involving 3,203 reported measles cases, including 16 deaths, with samples sequenced from 132 measles virus-positive cases.
analysis.methods: Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing were performed, with samples selected based on criteria including imported cases, travel-associated cases, representative samples from newly affected areas, and randomized samples from established outbreak locations every 2 weeks.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis showed the Israel sequences clustered most closely with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States, with 3 likely clusters within the dominant B3 lineage derived from separate importations from Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia; 82.7% of reported case-patients were unvaccinated.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that a single importation event was most likely the primary driver of the outbreak, with outcomes differing drastically based on local immunity, and highlighted the critical role of molecular surveillance in measles outbreak management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage and rapid genomic surveillance for measles outbreak control, as declining vaccination coverage poses profound risks to measles elimination status.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, limited by the exclusion of samples from established measles-positive locations and the lack of up-to-date global sequence data in public repositories, which could result in missing intermediate diversity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a major measles outbreak in Israel from April 2025 to February 2026, involving 3,203 cases and 16 deaths, threatening the country's measles elimination status. Genomic and epidemiologic analyses revealed that the outbreak was primarily driven by three separate importation events from Belgium, Vietnam, and Russia, with the largest cluster traced to an imported case from Belgium. The majority of cases (82.7%) were unvaccinated, highlighting the impact of declining vaccination coverage. Phylogenetic analysis showed clustering with sequences from the Netherlands and the United States, and the study emphasized the critical role of molecular surveillance in outbreak management. The findings underscore the risks associated with low vaccination rates and the importance of targeted surveillance during outbreaks.

That finding suggests the virus in fatal cases was typical of the outbreak strain. During weeks 39–44, as the outbreak expanded to additional districts, the overall ratio decreased (Figure 3); we observed a similar trend through February 2026 (data not shown). Volume 32, Number 9—September 2026 Dispatch Genomic and Epidemiologic Insights into Ongoing Measles Outbreak, Israel, 2025–2026 Suggested citation for this article Abstract An ongoing measles outbreak in Israel, involving ≈3,200 cases and 16 deaths, threatens the country’s measles elimination status and reflects declining vaccination rates observed globally and within Israel. Epidemiologic investigations supported by sequencing suggest that a single importation triggered the outbreak, underscoring the critical role of rapid genomic surveillance in outbreak control. Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable disease; clinical manifestations typically include high fever, maculopapular rash, cough, and conjunctivitis. Severe complications, including pneumonia and encephalitis, can occur in up to 30% of cases, and the case-fatality rate is ≈1/1,000 cases (1). Despite an effective vaccine (measles, mumps, and rubella [MMR]), measles remains a major global health concern; in 2025, Romania, Vietnam, Morocco, and the United States reported outbreaks (2–4). analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要调查以色列正在进行的 麻疹 麻疹,该事件威胁到该国的 麻疹 消除状态,并反映了全球和以色列境内 麻疹 率下降的情况。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年4月至2026年2月在以色列进行了一项基因组和流行病学调查,涉及3,203例报告的麻疹病例,其中16例死亡,并对132例麻疹病毒阳性病例的样本进行了测序。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行了流行病学调查并辅以测序支持,样本选择标准包括输入性病例、关联性病例、新影响区域的代表性样本以及每2周从已建立的暴发地点随机抽取的样本。
analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析显示,以色列序列与来自荷兰和美国的序列聚类最为紧密,其中 3 个可能的聚类属于主要 B3 谱系,分别来自比利时、越南和俄罗斯;82.7%的报告病例未接种疫苗。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,单一输入事件很可能是 麻疹 的主要驱动因素,其结果因局部免疫而异,并强调了分子 监测 在 麻疹 暴发 管理中的关键作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,维持高 疫苗接种 覆盖率和快速 基因组监测 对于 麻疹 暴发 控制的重要性,因为 疫苗接种 覆盖率下降对 麻疹 消除状态构成严重风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,受到排除来自已确定的 麻疹 阳性位置的样本以及公共存储库中缺乏最新全局序列数据的限制,这可能导致缺失中间多样性。
